blurb: `by Forged`, `by Stale` and the other bad-credential principals send a forged or out-of-date credential to the real auth seam, which only a `system` case reaches. In process the seam is skipped and the identity is simply given, so there is nothing to refuse. Move the case to `system` with `as system`.
summary: A case drives `by Forged`, `by Stale`, `by Expired`, `by WrongIssuer`, `by WrongAudience`, `by WrongAlgorithm` or `by NoSubject` outside a `system`-tier case; only the `system` driver signs a request or mints a token, so only there does the real `Signature`, `Bearer` or `Oidc` seam see the bad credential.
